text:
morgan: FYI - we're seeing a sudden spike in 504s after the 09:12 rollout. Canary at ~25% traffic shift. Customers reporting timeouts. sample req id: 0a1b2c3d

sandeep: on it. do we know whether these 504s are generated at edge or from the upstream auth gateway? any logs/snippets?

morgan: early logs look like upstream timeout to auth-gateway. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z ERROR proxy upstream timeout auth-gateway req=0a1b2c3d route=/v1/generate
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z WARN  gateway request timeout client=svc-x duration=200ms
```

marta: support note: two paying customers opened tickets complaining about increased latency and failures. CS escalated to SEV. Billing team flagged potential retries increasing cost.

sre-oncall: I see connection resets and a mixed 502/504 pattern across a few hosts. auth-gw p95 latency jumped from ~300ms to ~2.3s at the cutover timestamp.

jia: which config change went out in canary? I recall a traffic-shift flag + upstream timeout tweak.

morgan: yes — traffic_shift_v2 to route 25% to new auth-gateway variant + shorter upstream timeout (200ms). Might be too aggressive for some backends.

sandeep: agree rollback looks safest. @deploy-bot can you flip traffic_shift_v2 back to 0% and notify when propagated?

deploy-bot: acknowledged. executing rollback command:
```
redwood ctl flag toggle traffic_shift_v2 --env=prod --percent=0 --reason="504 spike rollback"
```

deploy-bot: toggle complete and propagated to control plane; estimated propagation ~45s.

sre-oncall: metrics trending down now — 504 rate back to baseline. I'll keep an eye on host-level errors for 10m.

marta: CS: customers report restored calls, asking for ETA on root cause & mitigation steps. I'll keep them updated.

jia: postmortem actions: revert the 200ms upstream timeout change in auth-gw config, add staged ramp (5% -> 25% -> 50%) with observability gates, and add a canary-specific circuit breaker config that tolerates backend variance. I'll open an RFC and link the runbook.

sandeep: addendum to runbook: do not reduce upstream timeouts below 500ms without explicit stage testing. Also add an automated rollback trigger: if 5xx rate > 2x baseline within 5m for canary cohort, auto-toggle to 0%.

marta: I'll coordinate customer comms and confirm billing impact is nil once logs show no retry amplification.

sre-oncall: keeping monitoring until +15m and then will close the incident channel. thanks folks. :thumbsup:

support-bot: incident ticket updated: SEV-2026-1587. Assigned to eng-oncall for follow-ups.
